summary: Trinity pilots the military helicopter away from the building as Agent Smith fires through the shattered window, punching holes in the rear hull. Neo and Morpheus, hanging from the helicopter by a rope, fall onto the roof of a nearby building. The rope remains attached to the falling helicopter, yanking Neo toward the edge. Trinity jumps out of the helicopter, fires a gun to sever the rope, and swings on it to catch Neo before the helicopter crashes into a glass skyscraper and explodes.

what_changes.before: Attached to the helicopter, falling with Morpheus
what_changes.after: Caught by Trinity, safe on the roof edge
what_changes.evidence: Neo flies like a skipping stone, hurtling at the parapet, when his feet hit the rain gutter and he levers up just as --

what_changes.after: Swinging on the rope, connected to Neo, as the helicopter explodes
what_changes.evidence: Holding on to the rope she swings, connected to Neo, who stands on the building's edge watching her arc beneath him as the HELICOPTER EXPLODES --

event_hint.one_line: The helicopter escape from the government building.

uncertain: Whether Morpheus is injured beyond the leg wound mentioned in the previous scene, as he is not described in detail in this specific scene text other than clinging to Neo.
